data.guideContent:
The Imperial Hotel Blackpool · North Promenade

The Imperial is one of those Blackpool hotels you know before you have even stayed there. Big Victorian seafront building, North Promenade position, trams outside and enough history that it feels very different from a generic chain box dropped beside a retail park.

Location

The hotel sits directly on the Promenade, north of the busiest central strip. That means you still have the seafront and tram connection but you are not sleeping on top of Coral Island or the Central Pier crowds.

For some people that is ideal: quieter base, then tram or walk down to the action. If you want to step out of the hotel and immediately be surrounded by arcades, choose something further south.

Food and current packages

The Imperial is operating much more like a destination hotel than a bare room-only base. Current packages include breakfast and, on some offers, dinner and entertainment. The hotel's own family-break information is now pushing all-inclusive style packages with meals, activities and extras bundled together.

The affiliate deal attached to this guide currently includes breakfast, late checkout and live entertainment, with a dinner upgrade on selected dates. Always check the final package because the exact meal plan changes between offers.

Parking

The hotel has parking, but it is charged. From January 2026 the hotel lists parking at £14 per car per 24 hours. Put that into your comparison straight away because three nights adds another £42 before you have spent anything in Blackpool.

Guest feedback

Tripadvisor currently shows 3.8 out of 5 from more than 5,300 reviews. That is not a score It is worth hide behind a glossy affiliate banner. The hotel has a huge amount of history and a cracking seafront position, but the guide record is mixed enough that It is worth read recent comments on room condition and service for your exact travel period.

That is the point of a Spin Raiders guide: show the deal, but also show the bit that helps you decide whether the building and current standards suit you.

Blackpool is where this hotel becomes easy to use

Our Blackpool directory is packed. You have Coral Island Casino, Carousel Amusements, Happy Dayz, Funland, Pat's 10p Prize Bingo, Arcade Club Blackpool, Tenpin, Pleasure Beach arcades, Grosvenor Casino and Genting, plus many more further along the promenade.

The tram is useful from North Promenade because you can move along the seafront without shifting the car every time. That is particularly handy if your day is basically a run of arcades, piers, food and attractions.

Who this hotel suits

This is a strong option for The Imperial if you want the old Blackpool hotel feel, a seafront base, entertainment and the option of meal-inclusive packages. Do not choose it automatically just because it says four-star: with a historic hotel this size, read the newest room reviews and compare the exact room grade.

Before you book

Check whether breakfast, dinner and entertainment are included in your chosen package, add the parking cost and confirm the room category. Spin Raiders may earn commission from qualifying bookings, but we want the full picture on this page before you leave for the booking partner.
